sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
instruct: Gender: male. Age: fifties. Role: blind mage scholar. Pitch: low, resonant baritone with a mystical inflection. Pace: slow, deliberate, with pauses that echo contemplation. Emotion: calm, philosophical, subtly patronizing. Characteristics: rich, slightly gravelly, with a breathy undertone when emphasizing lore. Use case: fantasy RPG dialogue in a ruined castle or submerged isle setting.
